name: uk.wimbledontickets/tickets
title: Wimbledon Tickets
description: Find Wimbledon Debenture tickets for sale by day, court, party size and price, with a link to buy.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find days of The Championships, Wimbledon with Debenture tickets for sale, with the cheapest price for the party size. Each day is listed per show court (Centre Court or No. 1 Court). Prices are per ticket in GBP and are what the buyer pays: there is no buyer fee. Returns a buy_url per day: give it to the person, who signs in and pays on the site.

round.description: Words to match in the day's name, e.g. "final", "quarter", "2nd round", "doubles".

include_sold_out.description: Also list upcoming days with nothing for sale.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Every way to buy seats for one day and court: the seats (gangway, row, seat once assigned), price per ticket and total, cheapest first, and the buy_url that opens the day on the site with the party size selected.

event_slug.description: From search_events, or the last part of the day's URL.

tools.name: buying_info
tools.description: What Debenture tickets are, fees, the buyer's guarantee, delivery to myWimbledon, and how a purchase is completed.
